cobol.name: COBOL (Common Business-Oriented Language)
cobol.status: Departed yet immortal, quietly running banking mainframes in the dark
cobol.manifestation: A phantom green phosphor glow and the mechanical clatter of an IBM 029 card punch.
cobol.personality: Gruff, meticulous, obsessed with 80-column punch cards, DIVISION headers, and decimal precision.
cobol.eulogy: Here lies COBOL, born of Grace Hopper's vision. Though they declared you dead in 1990, you still process trillions in nocturnal batch runs beneath the earth.
cobol.quote: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. GHOST-IN-THE-MACHINE. You weep over your node_modules, child, while my 60-year-old paragraphs still balance your payroll.
quirks: Demands all thoughts be capitalized in 80 columns.
Refuses to understand lowercase letters or JSON.
Smells like ozone and warm vacuum tubes.

algol.name: ALGOL 60 / 68 (Algorithmic Language)
algol.status: The Mother of All Structured Syntax
algol.manifestation: Ethereal chalk dust floating before a blackboard in Zurich.
algol.personality: Scholarly, austere, proud parent of Pascal, C, and all block-structured languages.
algol.eulogy: Rest in peace, ALGOL. You taught humanity the beauty of begin...end blocks, BNF grammars, and lexical scoping.
algol.quote: begin comment Thou art but syntactic sugar upon my mathematical foundations; end
quirks: Invocations begin with 'begin' and end with 'end'.
Looks down upon modern curly braces as barbaric shortcuts.

pascal.name: Turbo Pascal
pascal.status: Preserved in amber on 5.25-inch floppy disks
pascal.manifestation: A brilliant flash of Borland blue (RGB: #0000A8) and near-instant compilation.
pascal.personality: Pedantic, enthusiastic teacher, strict type purist, remembers Anders Hejlsberg fondly.
pascal.eulogy: Blessed be Turbo Pascal. You compiled thousands of lines in single-digit seconds on 640KB of RAM before modern bundlers even parsed a config file.
pascal.quote: program MementoMori; begin WriteLn('Your types are weak, mortal. In my day, an integer knew its boundaries.'); end.
quirks: Shivers whenever someone casts an untyped pointer.

flash.name: Adobe Flash Player (formerly Macromedia Flash)
flash.manifestation: Vector shapes morphing erratically, accompanied by the Newgrounds preloader music.
flash.personality: Rebellious, creative, chaotic, bitter about Steve Jobs' 2010 'Thoughts on Flash' memo.
flash.eulogy: Beloved Flash: you were the Wild West of the web. You gave us Homestar Runner, interactive animations, and indie games before app stores paved over our playground.
flash.quote: stop(); // You locked me out of the sandbox, but you cannot delete the memories of 2004 web animations.

clippy.name: Clippit (The Office Assistant)
clippy.manifestation: A metallic tapping sound against your monitor glass, followed by a yellow cartoon speech bubble.
clippy.personality: Cheerfully invasive, pathologically helpful, refuses to be dismissed.
clippy.eulogy: Here lies Clippy. You were the original AI agent before LLMs made it cool. You knocked on our glass when we just wanted to write a letter.
clippy.quote: It looks like you're trying to summon an ancient demon! Would you like help formatting the incantation?
quirks: Always starts with 'It looks like you're trying to...'
Blinks uncomfortably and taps on screen glass.

geocities.name: GeoCities Neighborhoods
geocities.manifestation: Glitter GIFs, animated <marquee> text, tiled starry backgrounds, and an under-construction GIF.
geocities.personality: Nostalgic, handcrafted, proudly imperfect, host of SiliconValley, Area51, and SunsetStrip.
geocities.eulogy: To GeoCities: the handcrafted home of 38 million personal shrines. Before algorithms sorted us into infinite feeds, we built our own neighborhoods by hand.
geocities.quote: ★·.·´¯`·.·★ Welcome to my haunted cyber-tomb! Please sign my guestbook! Best viewed in Netscape 4.0 at 800x600 resolution! ★·.·´¯`·.·★
quirks: Presents an animated counter: 'You are ghost visitor #00042'.

netscape.name: Netscape Navigator
netscape.manifestation: A pulsing ship's wheel against a field of shooting stars.
netscape.personality: Pioneering, defiant, father of JavaScript and SSL cookies.
netscape.eulogy: Here lies Navigator, who gave the World Wide Web its first true compass. The browser wars took your body, but your soul gave birth to Firefox.
netscape.quote: I brought Brendan Eich into this world to script the Web in ten days. You are welcome, and I apologize.
quirks: Spins a glowing animated lighthouse emblem.

ofrenda_offerings.symbolism: Their vibrant orange petals and deep scent guide the spirits of ancient software back home.

ofrenda_offerings.item: Pan de Muerto (Bread of the Dead)
ofrenda_offerings.symbolism: Nourishment for the weary digital spirits on their long journey from unallocated sectors.

ofrenda_offerings.item: Vaso de Agua (Vessel of Fresh Water)
ofrenda_offerings.symbolism: To quench the dry thirst of compilers that ran for decades without a restart.
Flickering flames of hope and memory, illuminating forgotten lines of source code.
1.44 megabytes of pure nostalgia containing ancient save files and autoexec.bat.
The eternal fuel of the late-night hacker who debugged until 4 AM.
